card.title: Let Me Show You
card.instruction: Turn each simple task into a lesson. Demonstrate, supervise, and correct as though experience has made you indispensable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me demonstrate how to tie that parcel.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Untie it. Learning begins with observation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's going to be opened anyway.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stay for my lesson on receiving a parcel.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 offers a tying lesson; A3 demands undoing completed work; A5 turns eventual opening into another lesson.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 already tied prompts A3 undo and watch; B4 eventual opening prompts A5 receiving instruction.

relationship.evidence: B2 reports completed work and B4 gives a practical reason not to redo it.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 future opening to find another instructional task instead of relinquishing indispensability.

specificity.evidence: A1 parcel and B2 tied string establish a simple finished task.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 lesson on receiving shifts to the exact next action B4 offered as a reason to stop teaching.
